title: Add sep parameter to utils.set_value for custom path separators
description: utils.set_value always splits nested keys on '.'. This adds an optional sep argument so callers can use other separators such as '/'. Docstring and tests updated.

bugs.description: The new sep parameter is inserted before value instead of after it. The existing caller in src/marshmallow/schema.py line 689, set_value(ret_d, key, value), was not updated, so the field's value is passed as sep and value defaults to None. Schema.load() then raises TypeError for non-string values or silently stores None / wrongly nested keys for string values. Fix: put sep last (value, sep='.') or update the caller.
